en: I warmed up well in the sun.
I didn't get warm with this blanket.
You (m.) warmed up with this hot tea.

lat: nta ma skhentish f had l-bit
en: You (m.) didn't get warm in this room.
You (f.) warmed up with this jacket.
You (f.) didn't get warm next to the fire.
The water got warm in the teapot.
The oven didn't get warm properly.
The house got warm a bit today.
The coffee didn't get very warm.
We warmed up when we ran.
We didn't get warm in the car.
Did you (pl.) warm up with the harira?

lat: ntuma ma skhentush b had l-kbotat
en: You (pl.) didn't get warm with these coats.
The children warmed up in the house.
They didn't get warm in the cold.
I warm up quickly when I run.
I don't get warm in this cold.
You (m.) warm up quickly with the coat.

lat: nta ma katskhensh b had sh-shurba
en: You (m.) don't get warm with this soup.
Now you (f.) are warming up in the sun.
You (f.) don't get warm without a blanket.
The weather gets warm in the summer.
The water doesn't get warm quickly here.
The house gets warm when it is sunny.
The food doesn't get warm without the oven.
We warm up next to the brazier.
We don't get warm at school.

lat: ntuma katsekhnu mnin katkherju l sh-shems
en: You (pl.) warm up when you go out into the sun.
You (pl.) don't get warm without coats.
People warm up in the hammam.
The children don't get warm at night.

lat: ghadi nskhen mnin ndkhol l d-dar
en: I will warm up when I enter the house.

lat: ma ghadish nskhen bla l-kbot dyali
ar: ما غاديش نسخن بلا الكبوط ديالي
en: I will not get warm without my coat.
You (m.) are going to get warm in the kitchen.

lat: nta ma ghadish tskhen hna bzzaf
ar: نتا ما غاديش تسخن هنا بزاف
en: You (m.) are not going to get very warm here.

lat: nti ghadi tsekhni b had l-manta
en: You (f.) will warm up with this blanket.

lat: nti ma ghadish tsekhni 7ta tdkhli l d-dar
ar: نتي ما غاديش تسخني حتا تدخلي للدار
en: You (f.) won't get warm until you go into the house.

lat: j-jaw ghadi yskhen ghedda f s-sba7
en: The weather will get warm tomorrow morning.
The water will not get warm quickly.
The house will get warm in the sun.

lat: d-dar ma ghadish tskhen f l-lil
en: The house will not get warm at night.
We will warm up next to the fire.

ar: حنا ما غاديش نسخنو هنا اليوم
en: We will not get warm here today.

lat: ntuma ghadi tsekhnu b had l-7lib
en: You (pl.) will get warm with this milk.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tsekhnu bla manta
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تسخنو بلا مانطا
en: You (pl.) will not get warm without a blanket.

lat: huma ghadi ysekhnu f l-7emmam daba
en: They will warm up in the hammam now.

lat: huma ma ghadish ysekhnu f l-jnan
en: They will not get warm in the garden.
